## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 372 captures during December 2018. The activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, with session lists managed as planned apart from routine leave. No material disruption to the service was identified in the period. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 372 captures, 17 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.6. The ungradable images were excluded from grading and should continue to be reviewed through routine quality-assurance processes. Overall, the image-quality result provides a measure for monitoring capture standards at Harbour Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 57 referable results. The median lag from capture to completed grading was 7. This measure should be considered alongside the recorded activity and image-quality results when reviewing operational performance for December 2018. The findings indicate that the service maintained planned activity while identifying cases requiring referral through the grading process.
